title: Your first test
hints: Test functions must have exactly the signature func TestXxx(t *testing.T), with a pointer. go test refuses to run anything else.
Errorf works like Printf: every verb needs an argument. Pass got for the %d.
Then add a second check where the first argument is the smaller one, such as IntMin(-3, 5) == -3. A version that always returns b passes your first check, but not this one.
